facts.text: GenWurtzExtract-v2 is registered with entry point chemistrylab.benches.extract_bench:GeneralWurtzExtract_v2
The registration passes only id and entry_point: there is no max_episode_steps wrapper, so the environment's own max_steps is the only step bound
GenBench defaults max_steps to 50
The episode ends when the selected Action is terminal or the step counter reaches max_steps
GenBench counts n_actions as one action per parameter row of every Action
GenBench builds a discrete action space as gym.spaces.Discrete(self.n_actions)

GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 has nine Action entries and its amounts parameters hold five rows each (np.linspace(0.2, 1, 5).reshape([5, 1])); the last Action holds one row, so the flattened list has 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 1 = 41 discrete actions
A discrete action is an index into the flattened (Action, parameter row) list, not into the nine Action entries
The last parameter row of GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 is terminal
The extraction bench's shelf has three working vessels
GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 observes layers and targets
CharacterizationBench measures 100 layer values per vessel and a target vector whose length is the number of targets
encode_target returns a one-hot vector over the targets
The chloro-wurtz reaction file lists seven products
GeneralWurtzExtract_v2 loads the chloro-wurtz PRODUCTS as its targets
The observation space is gym.spaces.Box(0, 1, observation_shape, dtype=np.float32)
reset accepts seed and options, reseeds numpy's global generator and the action space, draws a target uniformly from targets, and returns (observation, {})
step applies the selected action, advances every working vessel and returns (state, reward, done, False, {})
Most actions advance a vessel by dt=0.01 s; the two solvent pours and the final mixing action use dt=0 and the final Action is terminal
The bench metadata declares rgb_array rendering at 10 frames per second

determinism.notes: reset(seed) selects the target and initialises the stand-in's vessels; upstream seeds numpy's global generator and the action space, so one seed does not select the same target in the fake and upstream, and no trajectory was compared with the upstream environment

gaps: the fake is a stand-in, not the upstream chemistry simulator: it does not model vessels, material amounts, spectra, events or the reward generator, and its layer and target values are placeholders
the environment is event-driven, not a fixed-timestep integrator: each Action carries its own dt (0.01 s for most actions, 0 for the solvent pours and the final mix), so timestep_ms is declared 0
the action count follows the flattened (Action, parameter row) list and the terminal flag of the last Action, but the fake does not execute the named events
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
reset options are accepted and ignored, as the upstream reset does not read them
no rendering, no snapshot or restore (the environment exposes no get_state/set_state), and no wall-clock pacing
the fake returns the full observation shape (three vessels, each with 100 layer values and a seven-element target one-hot) but the values are placeholder data

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
